name: erp-process-transformation-agent
description: Evidence-backed, vendor-neutral ERP transformation suite for process diagnostics, O2C deep dives, internal benchmarking, initiative portfolios, and proof-of-value reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed ERP transformation diagnostics, internal benchmarks, and initiative value scenarios.
interface.longDescription: Turns supplied ERP process evidence into traceable findings, O2C deep dives, comparable internal benchmarks, initiative portfolios, and proof-of-value reviews. It distinguishes facts, observations, hypotheses, and assumptions; it does not provide unsupported savings or compliance assurances.
defaultPrompt: Run a rapid O2C diagnostic from our supplied process evidence; separate facts from hypotheses and identify the minimum validation evidence.
Create an O2C deep dive with process friction, control, data, and standardization opportunities backed by the supplied evidence.
Build a comparable internal benchmark across our entities using only the supplied evidence, cohort rules, coverage, and confidence.
Turn these validated findings into an initiative portfolio with owners, dependencies, risks, KPIs, and decision status.
Prepare a proof-of-value review for these O2C initiatives, including transparent assumptions, double-counting checks, risks, and validation needs.
